verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software product, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers practice areas, the Prarambh incubator and internal legaltech use. Nothing shows the firm shipping user-facing software with telemetry controls that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
